metas.name: Mean Girls
metas.description: Since you loved Clueless and 10 Things I Hate About You, this iconic teen comedy offers the same sharp wit, memorable quotes, and high-school social satire.

metas.name: Easy A
metas.description: Like 10 Things I Hate About You, this is a clever, literature-inspired modern high school comedy anchored by a brilliant, charismatic lead performance.

metas.name: Legally Blonde
metas.description: Perfect for fans of Clueless. It features an incredibly bubbly, underestimated female protagonist who conquers her environment with charm and intelligence.

metas.name: Stardust
metas.description: A whimsical, romantic, and highly entertaining fantasy adventure that captures the magical charm of Practical Magic and the epic fun of Dungeons & Dragons.

metas.name: She's the Man
metas.description: A hilarious teen rom-com adapted from Shakespeare, matching the nostalgic comfort and chaotic energy of 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: Enchanted
metas.description: A delightful blend of fantasy, comedy, and romance. It lovingly parodies fairy tale tropes with the same lighthearted warmth found in Practical Magic.

metas.name: The Princess Bride
metas.description: The ultimate feel-good fantasy adventure. It perfectly balances comedy, romance, and action, matching the tone of Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves.

metas.name: Rye Lane
metas.description: A visually vibrant, fast-paced modern rom-com with highly creative staging, matching the colourful, whimsical spirit of Night Is Short, Walk On Girl.

metas.name: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang
metas.description: Directed by Shane Black (who also directed The Nice Guys), this witty, fast-paced neo-noir buddy comedy is packed with hilarious banter and mystery.

metas.name: Logan Lucky
metas.description: A warm, high-energy, and deeply funny heist comedy with an ensemble cast, offering a relaxing and clever watch similar to Get Shorty.

metas.name: Knives Out
metas.description: Since you are looking forward to Wake Up Dead Man, dive into the star-studded, cozy, and highly entertaining mystery that kicked off the franchise.

metas.name: Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery
metas.description: The colorful, high-society puzzle sequel to Knives Out that delivers major laughs, eccentric characters, and a bright, vacation-like aesthetic.

metas.name: Free Guy
metas.description: An action-packed, gaming-centric fantasy comedy that matches the virtual-world high-stakes fun of Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle.

metas.name: Bullet Train
metas.description: A hyper-stylized, high-octane action comedy with a colourful cast of quirky characters, echoing the chaotic fun of Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: The Lost City
metas.description: A charming, star-studded jungle adventure comedy that captures the lighthearted romp style of Jumanji and Anaconda.

metas.name: Love and Monsters
metas.description: A surprisingly sweet, action-packed monster adventure that balances post-apocalyptic survival with feel-good humor and heart.

metas.name: Shazam!
metas.description: A highly comedic, lighthearted superhero film about a kid in an adult hero's body, bringing the exact same joyful energy as Jumanji.

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
metas.description: A perfect match for Thor: Ragnarok fans. It blends epic sci-fi action, retro music, and a dysfunctional, hilarious found-family dynamic.

metas.name: The Mummy
metas.description: A masterclass in fun action-adventure. It blends historical fantasy, creature-feature thrill, and charming romance like Jumanji and Anaconda.

metas.name: National Treasure
metas.description: The ultimate comfort action movie. It's a breezy, patriotic treasure hunt filled with fun history puzzles and charismatic heroism.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
metas.description: An eye-popping, high-energy superhero journey that is universally beloved for its comedy, spectacular action, and warm, uplifting heart.

metas.name: Borat
metas.description: If you braved the cringe comedy of Brüno, this mockumentary classic features Sacha Baron Cohen at his absolute wildest and most hilarious.

metas.name: Tropic Thunder
metas.description: A star-studded, hilarious, and action-packed satire of Hollywood that matches the self-aware comedic energy of The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Game Night
metas.description: A clever mystery-comedy about a game night gone wrong, offering non-stop laughs, great ensemble chemistry, and unexpected twists.

metas.name: Liar Liar
metas.description: If you love Jim Carrey's expressive physical comedy in Ace Ventura, this high-concept comedy shows him at the height of his hilarious powers.

metas.name: Shaun of the Dead
metas.description: A incredibly witty romantic horror-comedy that chooses cozy British humor and friendship over genuine scares, perfect for a fun movie night.

metas.name: Hot Fuzz
metas.description: A brilliant, high-octane action comedy that parodies buddy-cop movies with incredible visual humor and pitch-perfect pacing.

metas.name: The Emperor's New Groove
metas.description: One of Disney's funniest, most fast-paced animated comedies, focusing purely on hilarious buddy dynamics and slapstick humor.

metas.name: Scott Pilgrim vs. the World
metas.description: A highly stylized visual feast of action, romance, and comedy that perfectly aligns with the energetic fantasy vibes of Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Popstar: Never Stop Never Stopping
metas.description: A brilliant, lighthearted music mockumentary filled with catchy songs and absurd celebrity satire, perfect for fans of Brüno.

metas.name: Amélie
metas.description: A whimsical, heartwarming French romance with a quirky aesthetic, ideal for viewers who appreciated the stylistic joy of Night Is Short, Walk On Girl.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: An absolute masterpiece of pure comfort, kindness, and lighthearted comedy. It is guaranteed to boost your mood and make you smile.

metas.name: Howl's Moving Castle
metas.description: A breathtakingly beautiful, cozy fantasy romance from Studio Ghibli, perfect for fans of Fantastic Beasts and Practical Magic.

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: A hyper-energetic, heartwarming animated sci-fi comedy about a quirky family fighting a robot apocalypse, offering pure fun from start to finish.

metas.name: Kung Fu Hustle
metas.description: An incredibly fun, cartoonish live-action martial arts comedy that delivers top-tier action choreography and laugh-out-loud slapstick.

metas.name: Zombieland
metas.description: A breezy, highly entertaining road-trip comedy set during a zombie apocalypse, trading horror for fun rules, great chemistry, and big laughs.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: A hilarious, lighthearted mockumentary about vampire roommates, blending the supernatural with mundane, comfortable roommate drama.

metas.name: The Grand Budapest Hotel
metas.description: A beautifully symmetric, whimsical caper comedy filled with eccentric characters, witty dialogue, and a delightful, storybook atmosphere.

metas.name: About Time
metas.description: A touching, light fantasy rom-com about time travel, family, and appreciating the everyday moments of life. Cozy and deeply comforting.

metas.name: Bring It On
metas.description: A highly energetic, iconic teen comedy with sharp dialogue and fantastic rivalries, matching the cozy nostalgia of Clueless.
